title: Portugal
dek: Ten days by train between Lisbon and Porto, with a Sintra day trip between palaces and gardens — built around where people actually eat, not the tourist strips.
verified: ⚠ Pass A (canonical & verified) — Checked 2026-08-22 against primary/official sources (Parques de Sintra, museusemonumentos.pt, Câmara/diocese sites, CP, Carris, Metro Lisboa, Turismo de Lisboa/Porto, europa.eu, gov.pt) for entry rules, hours, prices, and transit. Not yet reconciled against a local/authentic second pass. Re-check before travel: ETIAS's launch status (unconfirmed as of Aug 2026, watch travel-europe.europa.eu/etias_en), Lisbon–Porto and Lisbon–Sintra exact train fares (cp.pt blocks automated verification — confirm at booking), Livraria Lello's exact ticket tiers, Porto.CARD's on-sale status (suspended since Jul 2026), and the current US State Department travel advisory level for Portugal (its page blocks automated fetch — check travel.state.gov directly).

entry.visa: Visa-free for tourism, up to 90 days in any 180-day period across the whole Schengen area (Portugal included).
entry.passportValidity: Valid at least 3 months beyond your Schengen departure date, and issued within the last 10 years.
entry.note: ETIAS (a pre-travel authorisation for visa-exempt visitors) is not required yet. The EU quietly dropped its Q4 2026 target in Jul 2026; 2027 is the most-likely next launch window but no date is confirmed — re-check travel-europe.europa.eu/etias_en before you fly.
